items.author: Meha Agarwal
items.content:
In less than a decade since its launch in 2017, Groww has gone from just a mutual funds app to a super app of sorts when it comes to investment and wealth management.
With 1.31 Cr active broking clients and consistently staying profitable, it has built one of India’s largest retail investment ecosystems.
Now a listed company with one of the largest consumer bases and a market capitalisation of about ₹1.24 Lakh Cr, or roughly $14 Bn, Groww is no longer the small platform that was taking on the discount broking giants of the world. It is now one of the targets and a benchmark for smaller startups in this space.
In FY26, its operating revenue rose 19% to ₹4,644.6 Cr, while net profit increased 14% to ₹2,083 Cr, despite tighter regulations and higher taxes on futures and options.
However, Groww’s growth has not yet translated into a financial lead over Zerodha, its closest competitor. While Groww’s active broking clients are nearly twice Zerodha’s 68.47 Lakh, the order was reversed in the latest comparable full-year financials.
An FY26 comparison shows the gap is closer but Zerodha is still ahead. Zerodha’s net profit grew 1.2% to ₹4,283 Cr in FY26, while revenue stayed at roughly the FY25 level of ₹8,847 Cr, as per what founder and CEO Nithin Kamath said.
Compared to Groww, Zerodha’s revenue is about 1.9 times higher and its profit about 2.1 times larger, against roughly 2.3 times on both measures a year earlier. So the gap has narrowed between these two giants because Zerodha’s growth rate has slowed down.
Bridging this gap further is now central to Groww’s next phase. However, as it expands across several verticals simultaneously, its growth will depend not merely on launching new products but on turning them into meaningful and scalable revenue streams.
In fact, Zerodha is attempting a similar diversification shift, building secured lending, asset management and has filed an application for a merchant banking licence.
So Groww’s diversification is a natural consequence of the market, but whether the company does so faster than competitors is the real question.
The reported financials from Q1 FY27 provide a clearer picture of where that money is coming from. Consider this: stocks and equity derivatives together accounted for 75.7% of Groww’s total income in Q1 FY26. By Q1 FY27, their combined contribution had fallen to 68.4%.
This decline did not reflect a contraction in these businesses, but the faster growth of newer revenue streams. In other words, Groww is gradually reducing its dependence on stockbroking and equity derivatives by adding new sources of income, even as the two core businesses continue to grow in absolute terms.
Diversification On The Anvil
Brokerage Motilal Oswal expects Groww’s newer businesses to grow faster than broking. A report from January 2026 when the brokerage initiated coverage projected revenue of approximately ₹7,980 Cr by FY28, with broking expected to contribute 67% by then.
“We further expect its revenue to double over FY25-28,” the brokerage said in its report.
But that’s still an analyst estimate rather than guidance from Groww itself. This projection also assumes that margin trading, commodities, credit and wealth management will become material contributors over the next two years. But that is yet to be seen in terms of actual absolute revenue volume.
Even when we assume that this forecast counts in the revenue diversification, it would seem that the new revenue streams do not carry the weight of this projection.
For instance, it implies that broking would contribute 67% of revenue in FY28, which is just marginally below 68.4%, the figure as of Q1 FY27.
So the revenue mix is only changing by a shade or two and not very dramatically. Plus, on an annualised basis, the Q1 FY27 operating revenue of ₹1,501.4 Cr comes up to about ₹6,000 Cr, against a projection of ₹7,980 Cr by Motilal Oswal as of FY28.
That would require a huge revenue jump and assumes that Groww will outcompete new players which eat away at market share with user acquisition drives.
The revenue equation changed very early on for Groww after it received its broking licence in March 2020 and entered stockbroking in June that year. The company turned profitable for the first time in FY21, posting a net profit of ₹2.72 Cr. In October 2021, it raised $251 Mn in a Series E round led by ICONIQ Growth at a valuation of $3 Bn. From there, Groww continued expanding its financial services business.
Along the way, Groww merged its US holding company, Groww Inc., with its Bengaluru-based Indian entity, Billionbrains Garage Ventures. The reverse flip aligned the company’s holding structure with its Indian operations and prepared it for a domestic listing.
The move, however, came at a steep cost. Groww recognised a one-time US tax expense of ₹1,339.7 Cr in FY24, pushing it to a net loss of ₹805 Cr despite remaining profitable at the operating level. With the one-time charge behind it, Groww returned to profitability in FY25.
Building The Product Stack
Between 2020 and 2026, Groww expanded beyond stocks and mutual funds into equity and commodity derivatives, margin trading facility (MTF), intraday and API-based trading, and credit products such as personal loans and loans against securities.
It earns brokerage and transaction fees from trading, interest and fees from MTF and credit, and commissions or distribution income from select financial products.
Not every experiment worked. Groww discontinued fixed deposits after limited adoption and its earlier US stock-investing product after remittance requirements, withdrawal fees and settlement delays affected the customer experience. It is now preparing to relaunch US stock investing through GIFT City.
Two acquisitions along the way took Groww beyond distributing third-party financial products.
In 2023, it completed the acquisition of Indiabulls’ AMC business for ₹175.6 Cr, giving it an asset management licence and the ability to manufacture and manage its own mutual fund schemes.
The acquisition of Fisdom for ₹961.05 Cr in 2025 added institutional distribution, bank partnerships and wealth-management capabilities. Groww also launched W in June 2025, a wealth-management service for affluent and high-net-worth investors.
Then, it piloted MF Prime in January 2026 and rolled it out more widely in July. The service combines an in-house research desk and artificial intelligence to offer personalised mutual fund guidance.
These businesses expanded Groww’s revenue model beyond brokerage. The question, now, is which of these businesses can generate meaningful revenue in the near term and meet the growth expectations of the market.
Scaling Products To Revenue
The immediate answer is unlikely to be direct mutual fund distribution, which continues primarily to serve as a customer-acquisition, engagement and retention engine.
Groww’s asset management company can earn management fees from the mutual funds it manufactures. Similarly, W, Fisdom and potentially MF Prime can generate advisory, management, subscription or distribution income. But these businesses are not yet large enough to drive Groww’s near-term revenue.
The asset management business could become a key lever. State Street agreed to acquire 23% of Groww AMC for ₹580 Cr in January 2026, valuing the unit at about ₹2,500 Cr despite its losses. Groww also bid for PGIM India’s asset management business in January, which would add scale inorganically. The longer-term case for the business is as a strategic hedge against slow down in F&O or broking.
Fisdom and Groww AMC remained small contributors in Q1 FY27, when Groww’s operating revenue stood at ₹1,501.4 Cr. During the Q1 FY27 earnings call, CFO Ishan Bansal said Fisdom had not yet recorded a significant improvement in revenue since the acquisition and remained in a gestation phase.
In the preceding quarter, Fisdom and Groww AMC reported operating losses of ₹10.2 Cr and ₹21.4 Cr, respectively. Groww expects Fisdom to turn profitable in FY28.
On the asset management business, the company said, “For it to be profitable, we need to grow our AUM 5–6x and this is expected to be achieved over the next few years.”
By comparison, Zerodha Fund House manages about ₹13,133 Cr. FY26 operating revenue rose 78.7% to ₹16.8 Cr and its loss narrowed 37.8% to ₹5.1 Cr.
Excluding Fisdom and Groww AMC, Groww’s platform revenue increased from ₹904 Cr in Q1 FY26 to ₹1,473 Cr in Q1 FY27. Consequently, platform EBITDA almost doubled from ₹499 Cr to ₹999 Cr, with the margin expanding from 55.2% to 67.8%, according to Groww’s Q1 FY27 shareholder letter.
At the consolidated level, total expenses increased 25% year-on-year to ₹555.7 Cr in Q1 FY27, considerably slower than the 66% growth in operating revenue.
Groww’s expenses are therefore increasing in absolute terms, but its revenue is currently growing faster. This leaves three businesses that are already showing measurable scale: margin trading, commodity derivatives and credit.
Margin Trading Facility Brings The Strongest Opportunity
The margin trading facility’s (MTF) contribution to total income increased from 3% in Q1 FY26 to 8% in Q1 FY27. On Groww’s reported total-income base, this translates into around ₹124 Cr.
As per disclosures, the funded MTF book surged 264% year-on-year to ₹3,775 Cr from ₹1,036 Cr, while Groww’s industry share increased from 1.2% to 2.7%.
This remains well below Groww’s 15.1% share of stock-trading turnover, highlighting the opportunity to cross-sell MTF to existing investors. However, active MTF users remained at around 1.3 Lakh between Q4 FY26 and Q1 FY27, indicating that the book’s growth was also driven by higher funding per customer.
In comparison, Zerodha’s MTF book grew to about ₹9,000 Cr in FY26, with customers borrowing about ₹6,000 Cr against it, and Angel One’s stood at ₹5,450 Cr. MTF now contributes about 10% of Zerodha’s revenue, against 8% of Groww’s total income.
Zerodha’s Nithin Kamath has publicly flagged the risk in the MTF boom for brokerages. “MTF is one area where the business growth is scaring me. The risk here is that the Indian markets could fall sharply. Leverage always looks great when markets are doing well, and the risks become obvious only when things go wrong.”
Unlike delivery trades, which generate one-time brokerage, MTF earns interest for as long as a position remains funded. Groww charges 14.95% annual interest, besides brokerage and pledge-related charges. During its Q1 FY27 earnings call, Groww said its cash-market yield had improved ≈5% year-on-year.
“We are seeing roughly ₹600 Cr to ₹700 Cr getting added on a quarterly basis on the book side,” CFO Ishan Bansal said.
However, MTF requires Groww to deploy capital and manage market, liquidity and customer-default risks. Its average MTF funding book increased 264.4% YoY to ₹3,775 Cr in Q1 FY27.
Following heightened volatility in Q4 FY26, Groww tightened limits across MTF and intraday trading during the quarter. Its profitability will therefore depend not only on book growth, but also on funding costs, collateral quality and its ability to contain losses.
There’s also the regulation factor. Groww’s shares fell after the RBI tightened lending norms for stock brokers, and rose in April when the regulator deferred implementation of the new capital-market rules. However, the segment Groww is relying on most is still exposed to a pending regulatory change.
Commodity Derivatives Is Scaling Fast
Groww introduced commodity derivatives in phases in September 2025. By month-end, 7,000–8,000 users were transacting daily and placing eight to 10 orders each. The segment initially contributed less than 0.5% of total income.
Active commodity users increased from 2.55 Lakh in Q3 FY26 to 3.93 Lakh in Q4 FY26 and 4.35 Lakh in Q1 FY27. Its share of total income consequently rose from 3.5% to 4.5% and then 4.9%. On Groww’s reported total-income base, this translates into roughly ₹76 Cr in Q1 FY27.
Groww also captured 28.6% of retail commodity derivatives turnover across the Multi Commodity Exchange and National Stock Exchange, having only entered commodities in October 2025.
Commodities require less balance-sheet capital than MTF or credit because Groww primarily earns brokerage on trades. However, revenue remains dependent on order volumes and market volatility.
“The scale-up in commodities over the next few quarters will be a function of growth in user adoption and industry momentum. We are still early in this journey,” Groww said in its Q4 FY26 shareholder letter.
Higher activity also raises transaction and servicing expenses. Groww’s Q3 FY26 shareholder letter said these costs increased partly because commodities scaled faster than expected. Therefore, while commodities offer a relatively capital-light source of brokerage revenue, they lack MTF’s recurring interest income and remain sensitive to trading activity.
The Secured Lending Bridge
Personal loans and loans against securities (LAS) contributed 5.5% of Groww’s total income in Q1 FY27.
On Groww’s reported total-income base, this translates into ₹85 Cr, compared with ₹62.6 Cr a year earlier. Groww distributes loans from partner lenders for fees and also originates loans through its own non-banking financial company, Groww Creditserv Technology, earning interest and processing charges.
But it must be noted that the share of income for the lending segment has declined. It was about 6.7% of Q1 FY26 income, against 5.5% in Q1 FY27. The segment grew roughly 36% in absolute terms, but total income grew faster.
Unlike margin trading and commodities, credit is contributing a smaller share of income than a year earlier, which makes its role in diversification a bit weak. Nonetheless, it’s a major opportunity for Groww
Loans against securities connects Groww’s investment and lending businesses by allowing customers to borrow against securities held on the platform. Its in-house NBFC’s disbursements increased 26.1% sequentially in Q1 FY27, with LAS accounting for about one-third.
“LAS is showing good growth, now it constitutes 34% in our disbursement,” cofounder Lalit Keshre said during the Q1 FY27 earnings call. Over the same period, secured loans increased from 13.5% to 18.5% of the portfolio.
For Groww, the focus on lending will increase as customer demand rises. This affects the quality and liquidity of eligible securities, funding costs and gives Groww greater ability to manage sudden declines in collateral values.
As LAS becomes a larger part of the portfolio, credit could add more recurring income while gradually making Groww’s lending book more secured. However, the disclosed numbers do not yet establish whether its returns can surpass those of brokerage.
The three engines, therefore, serve different purposes. MTF offers the strongest immediate route to recurring income from Groww’s existing stock customers. Commodity derivatives provide a faster, relatively capital-light source of brokerage growth. Credit creates a longer-term interest and fee pool, but requires more capital and risk management.
Together, they can reduce Groww’s dependence on equity derivatives. But the next rupee will depend not only on how quickly these products grow. It will also depend on whether Groww can scale them without allowing funding costs, market volatility and credit risks to erode the additional revenue they generate.
The Cost Of Becoming A Super App
While Groww has been operating profitably, diversification also introduces a different set of challenges.
Undoubtedly, Groww has reduced its concentration around stocks and equity derivatives, but it remains exposed to trading volumes, investor sentiment and regulatory intervention. That regulatory risk has already affected the industry as has been evident by the slower growth in the F&O business.
Stricter rules governing futures and options trading, including changes to contract sizes, weekly expiries, margins and transaction charges, have placed pressure on the economics of discount brokerages. These changes have reinforced the need for major discount brokerages such as Groww, Zerodha and Angel One to diversify beyond equity-derivatives income.
Operational and compliance setbacks add to this challenge. A January 2024 trading outage prevented users from placing orders and later resulted in a ₹34.12 Lakh SEBI settlement, without Groww admitting or denying the findings.
The platform also faced investor criticism over mutual fund holding and NAV-allotment discrepancies in 2024, raising concerns among traders over whether its technology and compliance systems can keep pace with its expanding user base.
Pertinent to note that such disruptions are not limited to Groww. Zerodha users reported glitches during a market rally in February 2026, amid the India-US trade deal.
Execution is another challenge, which we expect Groww will look to overcome in the next year or so to truly unlock operating leverage in the other revenue streams.
Groww is simultaneously building commodities, secured credit, wealth management, asset management, global investing, bonds, advisory products and AI-enabled services. Some of these businesses require regulatory licences and capital. Others require specialist talent and a higher degree of human advisory support.
However, Fisdom’s and Groww AMC’s losses show that each new vertical will not automatically inherit the economics of the core broking platform. Whether Groww can build several businesses simultaneously without stretching capital, management bandwidth and compliance infrastructure remains a key question.
For Groww, the next phase is moving a big segment or cohort of its customers towards higher-value services but doing so in a manner that does not weaken the low-cost structure that made the core platform profitable.
The fintech giant has a large customer base but unevenly monetised. Streamlining that into recurring interest, high-frequency and high-margin advisory services and asset-linked income is the next step that Groww will strive for.
[Edited by Nikhil Subramaniam]

items.author: Onsa Mustafa
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Mobile operators have increased tariffs by up to 22 percent over the past year, the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority (PTA) has admitted, while rejecting claims that telecom companies have been raising prices by 10-20 percent every month.
In a written response by the Minister In-Charge of the Cabinet Division, the government said PTA’s analysis of subscriber-wise top ten packages offered by Jazz, Telenor, Zong and Ufone showed an average tariff increase ranging between 12 percent and 22 percent from June 2025 to June 2026.
Mobile Operators Admit up to 22 Percent Tariff Increase in A Year: PTA
The authority, however, said the annual increase translated into a monthly tariff increase of around 1-2 percent, and there was no evidence of mobile operators increasing prices by 10-20 percent on a monthly basis.
The admission comes amid growing concerns among consumers over repeated increases in mobile package prices, with telecom users facing higher costs for calls, data and other mobile services.
PTA said it was regulating tariffs of Jazz, being a Significant Market Power (SMP) operator, as well as Ufone and Telenor pursuant to the merger order issued on November 30, 2025.
Zong, being a non-SMP operator, may revise its tariffs according to its commercial decisions, the regulator said.
However, PTA has the power to intervene where tariffs adversely affect consumer interests under the Mobile Tariff Regulations, 2025, it added.
See Also: Govt to Bring New Telecom Bill After Withdrawing Controversial RoW Legislation
The authority said that, under the law, it was mandated to protect consumers’ interests while also ensuring a reasonable return on investments made by telecom operators.
PTA regularly approves tariffs of SMP operator Jazz after taking into consideration consumer interests, inflation, prevailing economic conditions and market competition, according to the response.
It also conducts anonymous billing verification exercises to ensure that consumers are being charged according to approved rates.
The regulator said consumers facing tariff-related complaints or discrepancies in charging could lodge complaints through its Complaint Management System (CMS), available on PTA’s official website, CMS application and helpline.
PTA takes up such complaints with the relevant operator under the applicable legal framework for redressal, it added.
The PTA’s clarification suggests that while mobile tariffs have risen substantially over the past year—with increases reaching 22 percent in some cases—the authority does not consider the increases to constitute the much higher 10-20 percent monthly hikes being alleged.
The tariff issue has gained significance as mobile connectivity has increasingly become an essential service for households, businesses and digital users, making repeated price revisions a growing consumer concern.

items.content:
vivo kembali mengungkap detail dari lini smartphone flagship X500 yang dijadwalkan meluncur bulan depan. Kali ini, perusahaan mengonfirmasi spesifikasi layar vivo X500 Pro Max yang akan menggunakan panel BOE Q11. Panel tersebut menjadi salah satu bagian yang cukup menarik karena membawa sejumlah peningkatan pada kualitas visual sekaligus efisiensi daya.
bocoran dari Weibo mengatakan bahwa vivo X500 Pro Max akan menggunakan layar AMOLED berukuran 6,85 inci dengan resolusi 2K. Panel tersebut disebut sebagai layar pertama di dunia yang menggunakan material luminescent BOE Q11. vivo mengklaim material baru ini mampu mengurangi motion blur hingga 93% ketika pengguna melakukan scrolling.
Selain mengungkap layar, vivo juga menyebut panel tersebut memiliki peningkatan pada keseragaman warna hingga 43% serta brightness uniformity hingga 22%. Di sisi lain, konsumsi dayanya diklaim 21% lebih rendah dibandingkan panel generasi sebelumnya dengan resolusi 1.5K. Namun, angka tersebut masih berasal dari klaim vivo sehingga performa sebenarnya baru dapat dinilai setelah perangkat tersedia dan diuji secara langsung.
Baca Juga: iQOO Dikabarkan Siapkan Tablet Ringkas 8,8 Inci dengan Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro
vivo X500 Pro Max dengan Panel Q11 Fokus pada Visual dan Efisiensi
Dengan resolusi 2K dan ukuran 6,85 inci, vivo X500 Pro Max memang menawarkan layar yang cukup besar untuk sebuah smartphone. Peningkatan motion blur juga berpotensi membuat scrolling dan pergerakan objek terasa lebih mulus, terutama ketika menggunakan refresh rate tinggi. Keseragaman warna yang lebih baik juga dapat menjadi keuntungan bagi pengguna yang cukup memperhatikan kualitas tampilan.
Menariknya, peningkatan resolusi tidak secara otomatis membuat konsumsi daya semakin tinggi. vivo justru menyebut panel Q11 lebih efisien hingga 21% dibandingkan panel 1.5K generasi sebelumnya. Jika klaim tersebut terbukti dalam penggunaan nyata, peningkatan ini bisa membantu mengimbangi kebutuhan daya dari layar beresolusi tinggi.
Sensor Multispektral Ditanam di Bawah Layar
vivo juga menyematkan sensor multispektral baru di bawah layar. Sensor ini dirancang untuk mendeteksi temperatur warna dan spektrum cahaya secara lebih akurat. Data tersebut kemudian digunakan untuk membantu sistem menyesuaikan tingkat kecerahan layar secara otomatis.
Sensor tersebut dipadukan dengan kemampuan dimming hingga 0,3 lux yang diklaim dapat membuat perubahan brightness terasa lebih halus. Meski demikian, manfaatnya kemungkinan baru terasa dalam kondisi pencahayaan yang berubah-ubah. vivo sendiri akan memperkenalkan X500, X500 Pro, dan X500 Pro Max pada September mendatang, sehingga detail lain mengenai perangkat dan performa layarnya masih perlu menunggu peluncuran resmi.

items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Fans waiting for Grand Theft Auto 6 should be careful when looking for early access to the game. Cybercriminals are using the excitement around Rockstar Games’ highly anticipated title to spread malware. Fake websites are appearing online and claiming to offer a GTA 6 demo or an official game download containing malware. However, these files are not related to Rockstar Games. They contain information-stealing malware that can target sensitive data stored on a computer.
Beware! GTA 6 ‘Demo’ Is Actually Malware That Can Steal Your Passwords
The malware campaign comes shortly after Rockstar Games released an extended look at GTA 6. The new footage has increased interest in the game, giving scammers an opportunity to target eager fans.
According to Malwarebytes, attackers are creating websites that copy Rockstar’s branding and promotional material. These sites encourage visitors to download a file that supposedly contains a playable demo of GTA 6.
The downloaded file is actually an infostealer. This type of malware is designed to collect sensitive information from an infected computer.
The malware can search for saved passwords and login information stored in web browsers. It can also target browser cookies and authenticated sessions. This could allow attackers to access accounts without knowing the user’s password in some cases.
What information can the malware steal?
Malwarebytes found that the malware can look for several types of stored data. This includes browser passwords, session cookies, browsing history, download history, and saved browser profile information.
It can also target autofill data and credentials stored by FTP clients.
This makes the fake GTA 6 downloads particularly dangerous. Someone who downloads the supposed demo could expose information linked to multiple online accounts.
There is no GTA 6 demo
Rockstar Games has not released a playable demo of GTA 6. The company has also not made an early version of the game available for fans to download.
There have been several GTA 6 leaks before the latest official footage. However, these leaks mainly involved screenshots and videos. They did not provide players with a working game build.
This means websites claiming to offer an official GTA 6 demo should immediately raise suspicion.
See Also: GTA 6 Faces Another Wave of Leaks as New Footage Raises Spoiler Concerns
How to stay safe
Fans should avoid downloading GTA 6 files from unofficial websites. Rockstar’s branding and promotional images can be copied easily, so a website looking official does not mean it is legitimate.
Gamers should also avoid entering their passwords on suspicious websites. Checking the website address carefully can help identify fake pages.
The size of a download can also be a warning sign. A full modern AAA game such as GTA 6 is expected to require significant storage space. A surprisingly small file claiming to be a complete demo should be treated with extreme caution.
For now, the safest option is to wait for official announcements from Rockstar Games. Until the company releases a legitimate playable version, any website offering a GTA 6 demo should be considered potentially dangerous.

Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Pakistan’s Information and Communication Technology (ICT) sector maintained strong growth momentum during 2025–26, with export remittances rising 19.7 percent year-on-year and generating a $2.91 billion trade surplus, according to the Pakistan Economic Survey. Moreover, the number of IT and IT-enabled services companies registered with the Securities & Exchange Commission of Pakistan (SECP) also increased significantly.
As more Pakistani technology firms, digital agencies, e-commerce sellers and SaaS exporters expand globally, reliable cross-border payment infrastructure is becoming essential for managing currencies, controlling costs and funding growth.
Through its global financial infrastructure, Payoneer enables eligible Pakistani businesses to receive payments in major currencies, issue payment requests, manage funds and pay international suppliers and contractors. Its integrations with local banks and financial institutions further connect global earnings with Pakistan’s banking ecosystem through real-time local withdrawals.
“Pakistan’s businesses have the capabilities, ambition and talent to compete globally. However, international growth also requires financial infrastructure that can move at the speed of their business,” Nagesh Devata, SVP and Head of APAC at Payoneer. “By simplifying how SMBs receive, manage and use international payments, we are helping transform global sales into predictable working capital and long-term business growth.”
Stronger payment infrastructure can also support Pakistan’s wider economy by encouraging formal export receipts, strengthening SME cash flows and enabling more businesses to participate confidently in global trade.

items.author: Onsa Mustafa
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Google is making trip planning easier with new features in AI Mode. Google has added flights price tracking, rewards comparisons, and hotel booking tools to its AI search experience Mode.
These features aim to reduce the need to switch between different travel websites and apps. Users can now ask AI Mode about flights, monitor prices, compare rewards points, and find hotels from the same conversation.
Google AI Mode Can Now Track Cheaper Flights and Help Book Hotels
Google is bringing flight price tracking directly into AI Mode. Users can tell Google where they want to travel and provide their preferred dates. AI Mode can then search current fares across more than 300 airlines and travel websites.
If the user is not ready to buy a ticket, they can ask Google to continue monitoring the price. Google will send an email when the fare changes.
The flight tracking feature is available across more than 180 countries. It could be useful for travelers who want to wait for a better deal instead of checking flight prices manually every day.
Google has offered price tracking through Google Flights for years. The new integration brings the same idea into AI Mode, allowing users to manage the search through a conversation.
Rewards points can also be compared
The new AI Mode features also target travelers who prefer using airline miles and hotel points.
Users can ask AI Mode how many rewards points or miles they need for a particular flight or hotel. This means they do not have to visit separate loyalty program websites to check redemption rates.
At launch, the feature supports programs and companies including Alaska Airlines, Hawaiian Airlines, American Airlines, Choice Hotels, Hilton, and Wyndham.
Google also plans to add more programs. Accor, Flying Blue, Hyatt, LATAM, and Lufthansa’s Miles & More are among the services expected to join later.
This could make it easier for frequent travelers to compare whether paying with cash or using rewards offers better value.
Hotel booking comes to AI Mode
Google is also adding a hotel booking option to AI Mode. Users can describe the type of hotel they want and provide details such as their budget and preferred location.
AI Mode can then show suitable hotels along with reviews and important information. After choosing a hotel, users can select the “Continue on Google” option to move through the booking process.
The process includes selecting a room, checking the cancellation policy, and completing payment through Google Pay.
However, Google does not directly handle the hotel transaction. The hotel or booking service remains responsible for the reservation and customer support.
Rolling out in the US
The hotel booking feature is rolling out in the United States over the coming weeks. Google is working with several major travel companies, including Booking.com, Expedia, Marriott, and Priceline.
With these additions, Google is turning AI Mode into a more useful travel planning tool. Instead of searching for flights, checking rewards programs, and finding hotels separately, users can handle more of the process through one AI conversation.
The new tools do not remove the need to compare options before making a purchase, but they could make the early stages of trip planning much faster and simpler.

items.title: Apa Saja yang Ada di GTA 6: Extended Look Trailer via Netflix?
items.summary:
Pada dini hari 28 Agustus 2026, Rockstar bersama dengan Netflix menghadirkan trailer GTA 6 terbaru dengan memamerkan sisi gameplay yang lebih mendalam. Hal ini memang sudah dijanjikan oleh Rockstar, sehingga para gamer dan penggemar bisa melihat aksi Lucia dan Jason Duval sebagai duo protagonis dalam seri terbaru Grand Theft Auto.
Banyak penggemar yang sudah menonton dan melihat semua isi dari Extended Look Trailer tersebut. Namun, kami melihat banyaknya penambahan hal baru yang cukup istimewa jika diulik, terutama sistem dan konsepnya mirip seperti Red Dead Redemption 2. Itu yang menjadi salah satu yang membuat para gamer menjadi lebih antusias.
Maka dari itu, berikut adalah berbagai penambahan dan hal baru yang ada dalam game GTA 6. Mulai dari stats yang mirip seperti game RPPG, hingga polisi yang kian semakin cerdas. Jadi, bisa dikatakan ini menjadi game Red Dead Redemption versi modern dan lebih jauh dikembangkan.

items.author: Christopher Louis
items.content:
Pada dini hari 28 Agustus 2026, Rockstar bersama dengan Netflix menghadirkan trailer GTA 6 terbaru dengan memamerkan sisi gameplay yang lebih mendalam. Hal ini memang sudah dijanjikan oleh Rockstar, sehingga para gamer dan penggemar bisa melihat aksi Lucia dan Jason Duval sebagai duo protagonis dalam seri terbaru Grand Theft Auto.
Banyak penggemar yang sudah menonton dan melihat semua isi dari Extended Look Trailer tersebut. Namun, kami melihat banyaknya penambahan hal baru yang cukup istimewa jika diulik, terutama sistem dan konsepnya mirip seperti Red Dead Redemption 2. Itu yang menjadi salah satu yang membuat para gamer menjadi lebih antusias.
Maka dari itu, berikut adalah berbagai penambahan dan hal baru yang ada dalam game GTA 6. Mulai dari stats yang mirip seperti game RPPG, hingga polisi yang kian semakin cerdas. Jadi, bisa dikatakan ini menjadi game Red Dead Redemption versi modern dan lebih jauh dikembangkan.
Baca Juga: Bocoran GTA 6 Semakin Masif, Rockstar Games Buka Suara
Polisi Semakin Cerdas, Kamu Wajib Berganti Baju
Mobil polisi pada GTA 6
Membahas tentang polisi, terdapat sebuah indikator yang menunjukkan beberapa hal dalam trailer. Ini bisa kamu saksikan di Netflix dan ketika Lucia menjadi supir gateaway, pada bagian kanan atas tidak hanya ada indikator bintang saja, melainkan ada indikator wajah, gantungan baju, CCTV, mobil yang kamu gunakan, dan juga kamu bersama dengan rekan.
Kita bahas satu per satu. Untuk indikator wajah, berarti kamu sudah dipastikan akan mendapatkan tekanan dari polisi karena wajah karakter sudah diingati oleh polisi. Jadi, salah satu yang paling mudah untuk dilakukan adalah kamu wajib untuk mengganti gaya rambut.
Indikator yang akan muncul ketika berhadapan dengan polisi (Sumber: IGN/Instagram)
Kemudian, gantungan baju atau hanger. Itu berarti kamu wajib untuk membeli pakaian baru dan mengganti pakaian, sehingga polisi tidak mengenali pakaian kriminal yang sudah dilakukan. Ini menjadi salah satu yang belum pernah digunakan pada semua seri GTA. Ada juga CCTV yang berarti kamu sudah terekam pada kamera CCTV.
Terakhir adalah kamu terlihat bersama dengan rekan. Bila kamu menggunakan Lucia atau Jason, maka salah satu cara untuk menghilangkan indikator itu adalah kamu wajib untuk berpisah untuk sementara waktu, sehingga polisi tidak mencurigai keberadaan Jason maupun Lucia.
Dengan update tersebut, polisi dibuat menjadi semakin pintar. Tidak lupa, mobil atau kendaraan yang kamu gunakan akan dikenali jika kamu tidak diganti. Maka dari itu, kamu mungkin diberikan banyak pilihan untuk kabur dari polisi. Menurut saya, ini yang membuat game menjadi lebih interaktif dan tidak hanya sekadar kabur dari polisi.
Statistik ala game RPG
Jason Duval tengah membuka kulkas pada Extended Look Trailer dari Netflix
Ini juga menjadi perhatian kami ketika menonton Extended Look Trailer GTA 6. Terlihat ketika Jason membuka kulkas, dan terdapat adanya minuman. Maka, setiap minuman akan menghasilkan efek samping. Misalnya menambah darah atau menambah stamina dan kantuk. Ini sangat mirip dengan sistem RDR 2, ketika Arthur atau John meminum atau memakan makanan. 
Bahkan, kamu juga bisa melihat adanya adegan slowmo ketika Jason hendak menembak, dan itu memiliki konsep yang sama seperti Dead Eye, dan kamu bisa melihat adanya beberapa titik kritikal pada target. Ini membuat kesimpulan yang semakin bulat bahwa GTA 6 merupakan game RDR yang kian semakin dikembangkan.
Maka dari itu, pada sisi inventory nampaknya Jason dan Lucia bisa menyimpan beberapa consumable, sehingga ketika sedang kebahabisa darah bisa segera dikonsumsi untuk membantu pertarungan dan pertempuran tertentu. Ini hal yang membuat kami secara pribadi dan juga gamer ingin segera memainkan GTA 6.
Weight System ala GTA San Anderas Dibawa Kembali ke GTA 6
Weight System dalam GTA 6 yang berpengaruh ketika karakter melakukan Gym (Sumber: Rockstar Games/Netflix)
Pada trailer, kamu juga bisa melihat adanya adega gym atau fitness yang dilakukan oleh Lucia. Jadi, banyak penggemar berspekulasi bahwa dengan melakukan gym maka tubuh dari Jason dan Lucia bisa semakin prima dan terjaga. Namun, sebaliknya jika Jason dan Lucia tidak berolahraga, maka tubuhnya akan semakin membesar dan akan berpengaruh dengan stamina.
Hal ini pernah dibawa oleh Rockstar dalam game GTA: San Andreas. Dalam game lawas tersebut, para gamer wajib untuk membawa CJ (main character dalam game) untuk berolahraga, sehingga tubuh bisa menjadi kekar. Ini yang membuat game jadul tersebut terasa lebih realistis jika dibandingkan dengan GTA 5 atau GTA 4. 
Kembali lagi, dan bisa ditekankan bahwa memang GTA 6 akan menghadirkan banyak aktivitas di luar misi dan cerita. Bahkan, banyak penggemar dan pengamat mengatakan bahwa game ini bisa membuat para gamer menghabiskan ratusan jam untuk melakukan eksplorasi dan menikmati detail yang ada, seperti yang dilakukan pada Red Dead Redemption 2.
Mencuri Mobil tidak Akan Sederhana
Jason Duval dan Lucia Caminos (sumber: Rockstar Games)
Kita mengetahui, biasanya dalam game GTA 4 atau GTA 5 sekalipun, ketika hendak mencuri kamu tinggal menekan “Segitiga” atau untuk Xbox kamu tinggal menekan “Y”. Namun, untuk GTA 6 akan sedikit berbeda dan juga sedikit lebih rumit. Nah, yang membedakan adalah jenis mobil dan tahun keluaran mobil.
Dalam artian, jika kamu mencuri mobil jadul maka kamu akan lebih mudah, karena metodenya akan jauh lebih sederhana. Namun, ketika kamu hendak mencuri mobil yang lebih modern, maka kamu membutuhkan beberapa alat bantu agar berhasil untuk mencuri mobil tanpa harus “berisik”.
Mungkin, para pemain akan diberikan beberapa pilihan untuk mencuri mobil dengan gaya yang lebih halus tetapi membutuhkan alat atau mencuri mobil dengan gaya kasar, yakni memecahkan kaca lebih sederhana tetapi indikasi alarm aktif akan mencuri perhatian polisi.
Fisik Mobil Menjadi Lebih Realistis
Fisik mobil yang lebih realistik ketika meledak (Sumber: Rockstar Games/Netflix)
Shoot and Drive merupakan salah satu konsep yang tidak akan pernah luput dalam seri GTA. Jadi, Rockstar akan terus mengembakan hal ini, dan itu juga sangat terlihat pada Extended Look Trailer. Saat Jason menembaki mobil polisi, maka terdapat beberapa fisik yang membuat lebih realistis.
Pada ledakan dan mobil yang lepas kendali menjadi salah satuy cara Rockstar memperlihatkan bahwa mereka mengembangkan konsep Shoot and Drive lebih realistis. Ini yang membuat para antusias lebih tidak sabar menunggu saat game ini rilis.
Honor Meter Diadopsi Dalam GTA
Setiap respon dengan NPC akan berpengaruh pada cerita dan juga Honor meter (Sumber: Rockstar Games/Netflix)
Salah satu hal ikonik dari Red Dead Redemption adalah Honor Meter. Sederhana-nya, ketika kamu melakukan hal baik maka Honor Meter akan bertambah, begitu juga sebaliknya akan berkurang ketika kamu membunuh civilian atau orang yang tidak seharusnya disakiti. Ini pertama kali diadopsi pada game RDR 2, sehingga banyak orang melakukan banyak hal baik dalam game tersebut.
Nah, ini yang dilakukan oleh Rockstar ketika mereka mengembangkan game GTA 6. Biasanya, orang bermain game GTA akan melakukan hal semaunya, dan mungkin perilaku gamer akan berubah ketika adanya Honor Meter. Jujur, secara pribadi kami sangat menyukai Honor Meter yang diterapkan dalam game GTA 6 ini.
Salah satu yang sangat kami harapkan adalah Honor Meter ini bisa berpengaruh pada cerita dan juga bisa mempersiapkan ending yang berbeda jika kamu memiliki Honor Meter atau dishonor. (Saya harap tidak ada protagonis yang harus mati dalam game).
Kesimpulan
Secara keseluruhan, Extended Look Trailer GTA 6 memperlihatkan bahwa Rockstar tidak hanya meningkatkan kualitas visual dan gameplay, tetapi juga membawa lebih banyak sistem yang membuat dunia game terasa hidup. 
Mulai dari sistem polisi yang lebih kompleks, inventory dan consumable, aktivitas fisik, pencurian kendaraan, hingga kemungkinan adanya Honor Meter, semuanya menunjukkan bahwa Rockstar ingin memberikan lebih banyak konsekuensi terhadap setiap tindakan yang dilakukan pemain.
Memang, beberapa fitur yang kami bahas masih belum bisa dipastikan sepenuhnya sampai GTA 6 resmi dirilis. Namun, jika melihat apa yang diperlihatkan Rockstar sejauh ini, game ini terasa seperti evolusi dari berbagai sistem yang sebelumnya sudah mereka gunakan di Red Dead Redemption 2 dan GTA: San Andreas. 
Bedanya, semua sistem tersebut kini dibawa ke dunia modern Vice City dengan skala yang jauh lebih besar. Kalau benar-benar diterapkan seperti yang terlihat dalam trailer, GTA 6 berpotensi menjadi game yang bukan hanya dimainkan untuk menyelesaikan cerita, tetapi juga untuk menikmati berbagai detail kecil dan konsekuensi dari setiap keputusan pemain.

Informasi ini diungkap oleh kreator asal Brasil, Davy Jones, setelah berkunjung ke Rockstar North dan berbicara langsung dengan Rob Nelson, Head of Development sekaligus Co-Director Rockstar North.

items.author: Yus Lianson
items.content:
Grand Theft Auto VI atau GTA 6 dikabarkan berjalan pada 30 frame per second (FPS) di konsol, termasuk PlayStation 5 (PS5) dan PS5 Pro. Meski begitu, konfigurasi performa saat gamer resmi dirilis secara global pada 19 November 2026 masih belum dipastikan.
Informasi ini diungkap oleh kreator asal Brasil, Davy Jones, setelah berkunjung ke Rockstar North dan berbicara langsung dengan Rob Nelson, Head of Development sekaligus Co-Director Rockstar North.
Mengutip laporan Flow Games, Jumat (28/8/2026), build GTA 6 yang diperlihatkan dalam kunjungan tersebut berjalan pada 30 FPS di konsol. Flow Games menyebut, kondisi ini berlalu untuk semua konsol, setidaknya ketika dalam tahap pengembangan.
Baca Juga: Bocoran GTA 6 Semakin Masif, Rockstar Games Buka Suara
Davy kemudian menanyakan kemungkinan game penerus GTA 5 ini berjalan pada 60 FPS, termasuk bagaimana performanya di PlayStation 5 Pro.
Nelson belum memberikan jawaban pasti. Ia mengatakan perlu konsultasi lebih lanjut dengan tim teknis Rockstar sebelum memberikan penjelasan lebih detail mengenai konfigurasi performa game ini.
GTA 6 30 FPS Saat Rilis?
Fisik mobil yang lebih realistik ketika meledak di GTA 6 (Sumber: Rockstar Games/Netflix)
Flow Games menjelaskan, pada tahap pengembangan GTA VI saat ini, game tersebut masih berjalan pada 30 FPS di konsol. Laporan sama menekankan kondisi tersebut berlaku “untuk sekarang”, sehingga belum bisa dianggap sebagai konfirmasi versi final GTA 6 nantinya hanya akan menyediakan mode 30 FPS.
Push Square juga melaporkan, game ini menargetkan rilis pada 30 FPS di seluruh konsol berdasarkan informasi Davy Jones dari Rob Nelson. Namun, kemungkinan peningkatan performa masih terbuka karena konfigurasi teknis final belum dipastikan.
Perbedaan ini penting. Target performa selama pengembangan belum tentu identik dengan pilihan mode grafis yang akan tersedia ketika sebuah game dirilis.
Rockstar Games sendiri sampai saat ini belum mengumumkan secara resmi spesifikasi teknis final GTA VI, termasuk pilihan antara Quality Mode dan Performance Mode.
Apakah GTA 6 Akan Punya Mode 60 FPS?
Untuk saat ini, jawabannya belum diketahui. Rockstar Games maupun Rockstar North masih bungkam terkait Performance Mode 60 FPS untuk GTA 6. Nelson juga belum memastikan apakah opsi tersebut dapat tersedia ketika game diluncurkan atau ditambahkan setelah dirilis.
Detail teknis lain seperti resolusi rendering dan penggunaan ray tracing juga belum dijelaskan secara resmi. Hal yang sama berlaku untuk PS5 Pro. Belum ada informasi resmi mengenai apakah konsol tersebut akan mendapatkan mode grafis atau performa khusus untuk GTA 6.
Karena itu, terlalu dini menyimpulkan PS5, PS5 Pro, Xbox Series X, maupun Xbox Series S akan terkunci pada konfigurasi performa yang sama ketika versi final tersedia.
Gameplay GTA 6 Extended Look Direkam di PS5
Ada satu informasi mengenai performa konsol yang sudah dikonfirmasi langsung oleh Rockstar Games. Video Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look yang dirilis 27 Agustus 2026 direkam sepenuhnya menggunakan footage in-game dari PlayStation 5.
Rockstar menyebut video tersebut sebagai tampilan lebih jauh terhadap dunia dan gameplay GTA 6.
Informasi ini memberi gambaran, visual diperlihatkan Rockstar bukan berasal dari versi PC dengan spesifikasi lebih tinggi. 
Namun, penggunaan PS5 untuk merekam footage tersebut tetap tidak dapat dijadikan bukti bahwa versi final GTA 6 hanya akan menyediakan mode 30 FPS.
Konfigurasi performa masih dapat berubah selama proses optimasi menjelang peluncuran.

items.author: Usama Anjum
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Pak Datacom Limited has come under scrutiny over a Rs 556.8 million solar-panel transaction, with a detailed complaint seeking an investigation by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (SECP) into the company’s procurement, payment, internal-audit, and corporate-governance processes.
The allegations are contained in a 23-page complaint and accompanying internal records linked to former Pak Datacom chief executive Brigadier (retd) Syed Zulfiqar Ali, who headed the company for nearly five years.
Complaint document
According to the complaint, Pak Datacom paid Rs 556.828 million on May 25, 2026, to Karachi-based company MSBI as an advance for the purchase of solar panels. The same stock was later reported to have been sold to another Karachi-based company, Fabrica, with invoices issued in June.
Around Rs 556 million was expected to be recovered from Fabrica by August 31, 2026, according to the documents cited in the complaint.
The complaint questions whether normal procurement, commercial, internal-audit, and computerized recording procedures were fully followed during the transaction. It also raises concerns over the physical movement of the solar panels, approval mechanisms and the role of different departments within the company.
Pak Datacom officials, however, have rejected the allegations.
Ali Saleem Rana and General Manager Waseem Ahmed said the claims were being made by the company’s former chief executive and had no basis in fact. They maintained that major business and financial decisions at Pak Datacom are taken with the approval of the board of directors and in accordance with established company procedures.
Procurement, Delivery and Audit Processes Questioned
The complaint alleges that the transaction involved around 20 to 30 containers of solar panels and claims that parts of the deal may have been processed largely through documentation rather than the normal commercial workflow.
It further raises questions over whether gate passes and movement documents corresponded with the actual physical delivery of the goods.
However, the material provided does not conclusively establish that the goods were not delivered, and no independent regulatory finding on the allegation has been cited.
The complaint also questions the relationship between MSBI, which sold the solar panels, and Fabrica, which purchased them from Pak Datacom. It alleges that the two companies may have had a common underlying interest.
The accompanying documents, however, do not include SECP records establishing common ownership between the two entities.
Another major concern raised in the complaint is that Pak Datacom’s commercial and solar-business teams were allegedly not fully involved in the transaction.
It claims that senior officials including the chief commercial officer, general manager south, deputy general manager solar business, senior marketing manager and relevant account managers were either unaware of or excluded from important parts of the deal.
The complaint further alleges that the transaction was not subjected to a pre-audit despite an existing board-approved policy and was not fully processed through the company’s Odoo computerized system.
Pak Datacom management disputes these assertions and says the relevant business and financial decisions were undertaken with board approval and that the company possesses supporting legal and commercial records.
SECP Asked to Examine Governance and Financial Questions
The documents show that Pak Datacom had entered the solar business well before the disputed 2026 transaction.
The company’s solar expansion plans were discussed at the board’s 214th meeting in October 2022, when approval was given to import up to 48 containers annually.
By August 2023, Pak Datacom had begun importing solar panels directly from Chinese manufacturer LONGi. An April 2025 business plan stated that the company had imported and sold 25 containers, equivalent to about 10.7MW of solar panels, generating reported revenue of around Rs 364 million.
The complaint argues that the earlier direct-import model was more profitable than the 2026 transaction conducted through a local supplier.
It estimates that if around Rs 500 million had remained invested with a commercial bank for approximately three months, it could have generated returns of between Rs 12.5 million and Rs 15 million, compared with an estimated net profit of around Rs 10.5 million from the solar deal after taxes and other costs.
These calculations are part of the complainant’s assessment and have not been independently verified.
The complaint also links the transaction to Pak Datacom’s financial performance, citing a decline in earnings per share and revenue during the nine months ended April 2026.
On that basis, it alleges that booking a solar sale of more than Rs 500 million before the close of the financial year may have significantly increased reported revenue.
Beyond the solar transaction, the complaint raises questions over other company expenditures between July 2025 and June 2026, including alleged spending on vehicles, board meetings and committee-related payments.
It asks the SECP to examine whether competitive bids were sought, whether the procurement committee and full board formally approved the deal, whether any disclosure obligations arose for the Pakistan Stock Exchange and shareholders, and whether the transaction was consistent with the company’s constitutional documents.
The complainant has also sought an examination of broader allegations concerning possible misuse of funds, commissions and other financial benefits.
However, the documents cited do not provide conclusive evidence establishing money laundering, illicit commissions or diversion of funds, and no regulatory finding has been made on those claims.
Pak Datacom officials have maintained that the allegations are unfounded and that all major commercial and financial decisions were taken under board oversight and in line with established rules.
The matter now rests with the SECP, which has been asked to examine the transaction, the role of management, and the responsibilities of the board under the Companies Act, 2017 and relevant corporate-governance provisions.

items.content:
Dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, smartphone flagship HUAWEI selalu mencoba hadir secara konsisten memberikan pengalaman fotografi mobile tingkat lanjut, mendorong batas inovasi yang ada dari tahun ke tahun. Kehadiran HUAWEI Pura 90s Series 5G di Indonesia juga hadir sebagai versi terbaru dari pengembangan teknologi kamera hingga pemrosesan gambar berbasis AI terbaru dari HUAWEI, agar mampu menjawab tantangan yang kerap dialami ketika menangkap momen menggunakan smartphone.
HUAWEI Pura 90s Series 5G siap memungkinkan pengguna untuk dapat menangkap momen sedekat mungkin dengan apa yang mereka lihat dan rasakan, lewat penggabungan sejumlah teknologi terbaru. Mulai dari 200MP Ultra Large Sensor Telephoto Camera, sensor True-to-Colour Camera 2.0 yang eksklusif hadir di smartphone HUAWEI, hingga Advanced AI Photography Experience, semua dihadirkan lewat sebuah smartphone yang tampil premium. Memungkinkan penangkapan momen dengan detail, serta warna dan perspektif yang sebelumnya lebih sulit diwujudkan.
Lebih dari sekadar spesifikasi di atas kertas, HUAWEI mencoba untuk memberikan standar baru yang sesungguhnya di tengah persaingan smartphone flagship yang semakin sengit. Lantas bagaimana HUAWEI Pura 90s Series 5G bisa memberikan pengalaman memuaskan baik saat digunakan untuk menangkap momen paling spesial, hingga mendukung aktivitas harian?
Sistem Kamera Superior Untuk Sudut Pandang Lebih Beragam
Dinamakan HUAWEI Pura 90s Series 5G, tersedia dua pilihan flagship yang dapat Gizmo friends pilih sesuai dengan kebutuhan. Meski begitu, masing-masing tetap hadir membawa inovasi kamera paling mutakhir dari HUAWEI. Dan pada HUAWEI Pura 90s Pro Max 5G, dihadirkan sebuah terobosan baru melalui setup 200MP Ultra Large Sensor Telephoto Camera.
Ya, sensor telefoto smartphone ini membawa dimensi sensor 1/1,28 inci, notabene merupakan dimensi yang umumnya disematkan sebagai sensor utama. Dengan begitu, lebih banyak detail dan cahaya yang bisa ditangkap, terutama ketika dipasangkan dengan teknologi RYYB, diafragma f/2.6, serta stabilisasi tingkat hardware alias OIS.
Membawa 4x Optical Zoom, sensor telefoto HUAWEI Pura 90s Pro Max 5G juga mendukung fitur Telephoto Macro, alias mampu menangkap objek terkecil secara dekat dalam detail terbaik, untuk eksplorasi detail dari berbagai jarak. Tak hanya unggul pada sektor fotografi, sensor ini juga membawa kemampuan Industry-Leading 20x HEX Telephoto Video. Alias bisa memberikan pembesaran lebih jauh pada videografi, dalam kualitas yang tetap terjaga.
Menggunakan 1x zoom
Menggunakan 10x zoom
20x zoom masih bisa memberikan detail yang baik
Tidak hanya sensor telefotonya saja yang dirancang spesial, HUAWEI Pura 90s Pro Max 5G juga membawa Ultra Lighting HDR Camera 50MP dengan sensor besar 1/1,28 inci berjenis RYYB, 10 tingkat adjustable physical aperture f/1.4-f/4.0, OIS, plus teknologi LOFIC—memungkinkan penangkapan rentang dinamis yang lebih luas, termasuk untuk kebutuhan penangkapan gambar maupun perekaman video dalam skenario pencahayaan lebih kompleks seperti backlight maupun low-light.
Kamera HUAWEI Pura 90s Pro Max mampu menangkap warna yang kaya sekaligus akurat dalam kondisi low-light
Sensor telefoto superior membantu menangkap detail terkecil dalam sebuah makanan dalam ketajaman tinggi
Tidak hanya varian Pro Max, HUAWEI Pura 90s Pro 5G juga membawa Ultra Lighting Macro Telephoto Camera 50MP berjenis RYYB dengan 4x Optical Zoom, 8X Optical-Quality Zoom, diafragma f/2.1, serta OIS. Sesuai namanya, sensor ini membawa kemampuan fokus jarak dekat hingga 5cm, untuk menangkap detail objek seperti tekstur makanan, perhiasan, hingga lainnya yang mungkin sulit untuk ditangkap dari jarak normal.
Tidak hanya sensor telefoto unggul, HUAWEI Pura 90s Pro 5G juga membawa Ultra Lighting Main Camera 50MP dengan sensor besar 1/1,28 inci, teknologi RYYB, OIS, dan juga 10 tingkat adjustable physical aperture f/1.4-f/4.0. Kedua varian HUAWEI Pura 90s Series 5G juga didukung True-to-Color Camera 2.0 yang mampu membantu hasilkan reproduksi warna lebih akurat sekaligus natural.
Kombinasi sensor yang superior membuat kamera HUAWEI Pura 90s Series 5G mampu menangkap gambar hingga merekam video dari berbagai jarak dalam kualitas terbaik, memberikan pengalaman flagship dengan fleksibilitas tinggi. Mulai dari detail tekstur makanan, warna langit maupun pemandangan indah, sampai warna kulit, semua dapat ditangkap dalam kualitas dan visual yang lebih nyata, alias mendekati apa yang terlihat oleh pandangan mata.
Diperkuat Fitur Advanced AI Untuk Sempurnakan Setiap Momen
Selain mengandalkan kombinasi hardware yang inovatif, HUAWEI Pura 90s Series 5G juga diperkuat serangkaian fitur AI yang mampu membantu menangkap momen terbaik, tidak hanya setelah gambar ditangkap, namun juga dalam proses penangkapannya. Beberapa di antaranya termasuk AI Remove yang bisa menghapus objek mengganggu dalam gambar, AI Best Expression untuk mengubah ekspresi wajah menjadi yang terbaik dalam sebuah foto grup, hingga AI De-glare untuk membantu mengurangi efek pantulan agar objek terlihat lebih jelas.
Namun selain ketiga fitur AI tersebut, HUAWEI Pura 90s Series 5G juga membawa fitur eksklusif bernama AI Composition. Ya, sesuai namanya, pengguna akan mendapatkan panduan komposisi pengambilan gambar secara real-time, demi framing optimal. Tidak hanya angle, juga rentang zoom yang pas sesuai dengan skenario yang terdeteksi oleh kamera. Setelah gambar tertangkap, ada AI Move yang memungkinkan objek pada gambar dipindahkan tata letaknya, untuk komposisi lebih kreatif.
Petal Interconnect Mempermudah File Sharing, Tampil dalam Opsi Warna Segar
Untuk membagikan momen yang berhasil ditangkap dalam kualitas tinggi, kedua smartphone kini mengusung Petal Interconnect. Sebuah fitur yang memudahkan pengiriman file antar perangkat HUAWEI dengan iOS, sebagai opsi kirim data yang jauh lebih seamless. HUAWEI Pura 90s Series 5G juga hadir membawa dukungan hingga 100W Wired HUAWEI SuperCharge dan 80W Wireless HUAWEI SuperCharge untuk varian Pro Max, lengkap dengan perlindungan Anti-Reflection and Scratch-Resistant Kunlun Glass serta sertifikasi IP68 dan IP69 yang membuatnya tahan debu serta air.
HUAWEI Pura 90s Pro Max 5G hadir dalam opsi warna Orange Ocean, Blush Gold, serta Graphite Black. Sementara HUAWEI Pura 90s Pro yang membawa dukungan 66W Wired dan 50W Wireless SuperCharge, tersedia dalam warna Guava Soda, Orange Soda, Coconut White, dan Mulberry Black. Dan tentunya, pengguna dapat mengakses kebutuhan digital harian secara komplit lewat HUAWEI AppGallery.
Aplikasi Tersedia Komplit di HUAWEI AppGallery
Ketersediaan atau ekosistem aplikasi tentu menjadi penting, sebagai pelengkap pengalaman menggunakan smartphone flagship. Dan melalui HUAWEI AppGallery, pengguna HUAWEI Pura 90s Series 5G bisa mendapatkan semua aplikasi yang dibutuhkan untuk aktivitas termasuk produktivitas harian. Mulai dari perbankan, hiburan, hingga kreasi konten.
Aplikasi harian seperti WhatsApp, Instagram, TikTok, Spotify, hingga Netflix tentu tersedia. Bagaimana dengan e-commerce maupun super app? Juga tersedia, mulai Gojek, Grab, Shopee, dan Tokopedia. Konten kreator juga bisa mendapatkan CapCut hingga Canva dan Lightroom, sementara aplikasi perbankan seperti BCA mobile, Livin’ by Mandiri, BRImo, BNI Mobile Banking, hingga e-wallet seperti DANA, GoPay, OVO, hingga ShopeePay juga bisa didapatkan. 
Bahkan untuk Gizmo friends yang sudah menggunakan platform AI dalam keseharian, juga bisa mengakses Gemini, DeepSeek, hingga Dola secara lancar. Sistem keamanan 360° Protection HUAWEI AppGallery juga hadir memastikan bila semua aplikasi di dalamnya terjamin aman, karena harus melalui sejumlah proses khusus seperti verifikasi pengembang, pemindaian malware, perlindungan privasi, hingga pemeriksaan integritas aplikasi. 
HUAWEI Pura 90s Series 5G Sudah Bisa Dipesan, Bonus Hingga Rp8,4 Juta
Tertarik untuk membeli flagship HUAWEI terbaru? HUAWEI Pura 90s Pro Max 5G 12GB + 512GB dibanderol Rp22.999 juta, sementara HUAWEI Pura 90s Pro 5G 12GB + 512GB dipasarkan dengan harga Rp17.999 juta.
Pada September mendatang, HUAWEI juga akan menghadirkan varian dengan kapasitas penyimpanan 256GB, yakni HUAWEI Pura 90s Pro Max 5G 12GB + 256GB dengan harga Rp20.999 juta dan HUAWEI Pura 90 Pro 5G 12GB + 256GB seharga Rp15.999 juta.
Bonus tersebut terdiri dari Free 2x Memory Upgrade senilai Rp2 juta, HUAWEI Watch Fit 4 senilai Rp1,8 juta, Bank Cashback senilai hingga Rp2 juta, serta proteksi HUAWEI Care senilai Rp2,6 juta. Proteksi tersebut mencakup kerusakan yang tidak disengaja selama 1 tahun, serta layanan penggantian screen protector hingga 4 kali selama 2 tahun.
HUAWEI juga memberikan opsi pembiayaan lewat Home Credit dengan bunga 0%, bebas biaya administrasi, serta bebas DP. Dan untuk melengkapi peluncuran HUAWEI Pura 90s Series di Indonesia, HUAWEI berkolaborasi dengan AMAN, menghadirkan pengalaman premium bagi para konsumen.
Selama periode hingga 31 Oktober 2026, konsumen yang memenuhi syarat, bisa menikmati penawaran khusus yakni exclusive stay offer hingga 40% di sejumlah property AMAN di Indonesia. HUAWEI Pura 90s Series tersedia secara daring di HUAWEI Store, Shopee, Lazada, Tokopedia, TikTok Shop, Blibli, erafone.com, dan Eraspace. Dan tentunya juga bisa dipesan secara luring melalui jaringan HUAWEI Authorized Experience Store, Erafone, Blibli, Urban Republic, Digiplus, serta peritel resmi HUAWEI lainnya.

items.author: Usama Anjum
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
The Ministry of Information Technology and Telecommunication is preparing to introduce a fresh Pakistan Telecommunications (Reorganization) Amendment Bill, 2026, after deciding to withdraw the existing legislation from the Senate in an effort to avoid further procedural delays.
In a statement issued on August 28, the ministry said the current bill was nearing the end of its 90-day constitutional period in the Senate.
Once that period expired, the legislation would have moved to a joint sitting of Parliament, which the ministry said might not be convened in the near future.
To prevent the process from slowing further, MoITT said it had chosen to withdraw the current bill and introduce a fresh version through the regular legislative route.
The ministry said the new bill would retain the core substance and policy intent of the proposed legislation while allowing the process to move forward in a more timely and effective manner.
The development comes after the earlier telecom amendment bill faced criticism and prolonged scrutiny in the Senate, particularly over provisions linked to right-of-way, telecom infrastructure deployment and access to private property.
Lawmakers had raised concerns over how some of the proposed provisions could affect property rights and the process through which telecom operators gain access for fiber, towers, and other infrastructure.
The government’s latest move indicates that it is not abandoning the broader telecom reform agenda. Instead, it is seeking a faster legislative route by restarting the process with a new bill.
The fresh draft could also give the ministry an opportunity to refine contested provisions while preserving the broader objective of creating a more streamlined framework for telecom infrastructure and right-of-way issues.
Pakistan’s telecom sector has long cited inconsistent approval processes, infrastructure permissions, and right-of-way disputes as major barriers to faster fibre and network expansion.
With the previous bill now being withdrawn, attention will shift to the timing and contents of the fresh legislation, which MOITT is expected to bring before Parliament as the next step in its telecom reform agenda.

Perangkat ini membawa layar berukuran 12,1 inci dengan resolusi 2.5K, chipset MediaTek Dimensity 6400, serta sistem operasi Android. Beberapa varian juga sudah dibekali Lenovo Tab Pen dan keyboard.
Dengan ukuran layar yang cukup besar, Lenovo IdeaTab Plus mencoba menawarkan pengalaman yang lebih fleksibel dibandingkan tablet berukuran kecil. Pengguna dapat memanfaatkannya untuk membaca dokumen, mencatat materi, mengikuti meeting online, hingga mengerjakan pekerjaan dengan dukungan sejumlah aplikasi Google seperti Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive, dan Gmail.
Lenovo IdeaTab Plus juga menyematkan sejumlah fitur berbasis AI seperti Lenovo AI Notes, Google Gemini, dan Circle to Search. AI Notes dapat membantu merapikan serta merangkum catatan, sementara Gemini dapat digunakan untuk mencari ide atau membantu kebutuhan menulis. Namun, fitur AI semacam ini tetap lebih tepat dipandang sebagai pendukung produktivitas, bukan pengganti seluruh pekerjaan pengguna.

Desain dari Lenovo IdeaTab Plus dengan semua varian warna
IdeaTab Plus memiliki layar 12,1 inci dengan resolusi 2560 x 1600, refresh rate hingga 90Hz, cakupan hingga 96% DCI-P3, dan tingkat kecerahan maksimal 800 nits. Kombinasi tersebut cukup menarik untuk tablet di kelas harganya, terutama bagi pengguna yang sering membaca dokumen atau menjalankan beberapa aplikasi sekaligus.
Di sisi mobilitas, perangkat memiliki ketebalan sekitar 6,29 mm dan bobot sekitar 530 gram. Lenovo juga menyediakan Tab Pen untuk mencatat atau melakukan anotasi, sementara Folio Keyboard tersedia pada beberapa varian. Pendekatan ini membuat tablet lebih fleksibel, meski pengguna yang membutuhkan pengalaman laptop secara penuh tetap akan menemukan keterbatasan dari sistem operasi Android.
Harga Mulai Rp6,1 Jutaan
Untuk performanya, Lenovo IdeaTab Plus menggunakan MediaTek Dimensity 6400 dengan pilihan RAM hingga 8GB dan penyimpanan hingga 256GB. Kapasitas penyimpanan masih dapat diperluas menggunakan microSD hingga 2TB. Lenovo juga membekali tablet dengan baterai 10.200mAh dan dukungan pengisian daya 45W.
Lenovo Idea Tab Plus tersedia dalam warna Luna Grey, Cloud Grey, dan Sand Rose. Harga termurah berada di Rp6.199.000 untuk varian 8GB+128GB dengan Lenovo Tab Pen. Sementara varian 8GB+128GB yang sudah mendapatkan Tab Pen dan Folio Keyboard dibanderol Rp6.699.000, sedangkan varian 8GB+256GB dengan kedua aksesori tersebut mencapai Rp7.499.000. Dengan pilihan tersebut, tablet ini cukup menarik bagi pengguna yang membutuhkan perangkat Android berlayar besar untuk produktivitas, tetapi tetap perlu mempertimbangkan kebutuhan software sebelum menjadikannya pengganti laptop.

items.author: Tom Jackson
items.content:
Nigerian agri-tech startup UfarmX, which leverages blockchain technology to empower rural, unbanked and underserved smallholder farmers, has facilitated over US$6.8 million in agricultural commerce across Nigeria, Senegal, and Liberia, with further expansion into Kenya planned.
The UfarmX platform does various different things, connecting farmers to quality inputs, much of it on credit utilising a transparent blockchain ledger; allowing them access to markets post-harvest; and giving them the data they need to scale their operations.
Disrupt Africa reported in 2023 the startup had expanded to Senegal, and it is now also active in Liberia. Across those three markets, where Ufarmx works with over 17,000 credit-scored farmers and a growing network of vetted retail partners, it has facilitated over US$6.8 million in agricultural commerce.
Its insured retailer channel is running a net default rate of 1.17 per cent, collateral-free, in a sector the continent’s banks price as untouchable. Alexander Zanders, CEO of UfarmX, told Disrupt Africa the startup had launched with direct lending to prove the model.
“Farmers repaid, yields improved, revenues grew. But banks move too slowly to build a company around. So we built the retail model instead – local retailers extend credit to farmers using our data, without needing a bank in the loop at all,” he said.
This is simply phase one for UfarmX, with phase two arriving at the end of this year – a credit-scoring API that lets banks and financial institutions process agricultural loan applications directly on UfarmX’s underwriting, the way American lenders run decisions on Equifax or Experian.
An expansion into Kenya, the company’s first East African market, is also planned for Q4. Ahead of the API launch, UfarmX is opening conversations with banks, DFIs, insurers, and input producers that want early access to the underwriting rail.
“African agriculture gets looked at through the lens of impact, when the opportunity for capitalisation is immense. This isn’t charity. It’s the largest credit market still sitting untouched,” said Zanders.

items.author: Kavit Majithia
items.content:
INTERVIEW: The director general of the Cellular Operators Association of India (COAI) argued the country is better placed than some global rivals to become a 6G leader, but conceded there could be some “slippages” on the road to a commercial launch in 2030.
Speaking on the Mobile World Live Podcast, S.P Kochhar (pictured) reiterated the government’s ambitions for India to take a leading role in developing the technology, insisting this “is not just a statement” and active steps are being taken to make it happen.
He pointed to concrete examples including a drive to ensure at least 10% of global 6G patents come from India, the formation of relevant committees and forums, and investment in fabrication plants to ensure silicon is being made in the country.
This last point, he believes, is giving India a competitive advantage.
“Because of the cost differential with the western world, we should be in a better position, better placed, to provide 6G compared to others.”
He also pointed out some countries may be able to manufacture cheaper or on par, but “the trust factor is also in favour of India”.
With a push to integrate AI across the entire process and development of quantum, Kochhar argues “it is a very well-planned roadmap which has been enunciated and put into practice”.
He continued: “This time around, it is not a policy which will remain in the cupboard.”
Eyebrows
Kochhar dismissed any notions that India was late to the party when it came to 5G, stating it is not the nation’s responsibility “to reinvent zero”. It is, in fact, using the mistakes from others in the 5G era to avoid the same problems with 6G.
“If we can learn from others’ mistakes, why should I commit a mistake?” he asked.
While Kochhar subscribes to the government’s bullishness around 6G, he did admit there could be some bumps in the road, particularly in keeping pace with a widely-expected launch for the technology in 2030.
“I see some slippages there because 5G monetisation has not taken place the way it should,” he said. “Putting in more money in 6G at this point in time may raise eyebrows and that might delay the programme for some time. But that is my personal view.”

items.author: Staff
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
The government has moved ahead with the establishment of a sovereign, cloud-based and AI-enabled data centre of the National Telecommunication Corporation (NTC) in Karachi, with the project already entering the procurement phase.
Minister for Information Technology and Telecommunications Shaza Fatima Khawaja, in a written reply to the National Assembly, said the “Establishment of NTC Data Center at Karachi” project was approved under the Annual Development Programme (ADP) 2025-26 and is currently under procurement.
The minister said the facility has been designed primarily to cater to the market of NTC’s South Region, including government entities operating in the region. The initial setup is being procured at present and would subsequently be scaled up according to the requirements of government clients.
According to NTC, the project is aimed at establishing sovereign data centre infrastructure within Pakistan, reducing dependence on foreign cloud platforms while providing basic AI services and strengthening data sovereignty, cybersecurity, regulatory compliance and operational resilience.
The facility is expected to address the growing computing and storage requirements of the NTC South Region and provide localized hosting services to federal and provincial government entities operating across Sindh and Balochistan.
NTC said the data centre would offer Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS), Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS), disaster recovery and business continuity services. The regional facility is expected to reduce pressure on infrastructure nodes in northern parts of the country while improving the reliability, availability and response times of critical e-governance platforms.
The government also expects the Karachi facility to reinforce implementation of the Pakistan Cloud First Policy by providing a standardized and secure domestic cloud framework for government organizations.
NTC said keeping public-sector data within Pakistan’s geographical boundaries would help shield government data from foreign supply-chain risks, international pricing fluctuations and geopolitical vulnerabilities.
In a significant step towards establishing NTC as a trusted sovereign cloud provider, seven applications have been submitted for accreditation under the Pakistan Cloud First Policy, including NTC itself, the reply added.
The Karachi data centre will also incorporate foundational AI capabilities in line with Pakistan’s emerging National AI Policy framework.
According to NTC, its regional AI-capable node would operate through a vendor-neutral computing stack and sovereign, locally contextualized large language models (LLMs), enabling secure AI inference and model deployment for strategic public-sector applications.
The facility is also expected to give a push to the domestic IT sector by enabling government institutions to shift from expensive foreign cloud platforms to locally hosted infrastructure, potentially reducing operational costs and conserving foreign exchange.
NTC said the scalable architecture of the data centre would allow capacity to be expanded in line with market demand, creating infrastructure for the growth of e-governance, digital public services and technology-driven innovation in sectors including health, education, finance and industry.
The project, therefore, is being positioned not merely as a regional data centre but as a key component of Pakistan’s efforts to build sovereign digital infrastructure, strengthen control over government data and support the country’s transition towards cloud and AI-enabled public services.

items.author: Staff
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
The Universal Service Fund (USF) has provided voice and broadband access to more than 16.2 million people living in 9,400-plus underserved and unserved mauzas during the last five fiscal years, while deploying over 10,400 kilometres of optic fibre cable (OFC) and connecting 947 unserved areas.
According to a written reply submitted by Minister for Information Technology and Telecommunication Shaza Fatima Khawaja to the National Assembly, USF projects have significantly expanded digital connectivity in rural and remote areas where commercial deployment by telecom operators was not considered viable.
The ministry said USF interventions had enabled broadband services for the first time in several target areas and helped bridge the communication gap in unserved and underserved communities.
During FY2022-26, USF access projects provided voice and broadband data services to 16.2 million-plus people residing in more than 9,400 mauzas.
The fund also provided broadband coverage along more than 1,000 kilometres of previously unserved road segments on national highways and motorways, besides covering eight tourist destinations and around 50 kilometres of access routes.
Under its optic-fibre backhaul programme, USF deployed 10,400-plus kilometres of OFC during the last five fiscal years, connecting 947 unserved tehsil headquarters, union councils and towns.
The government said USF had been established under Section 33(A)(1) of the Pakistan Telecommunication (Re-organization) Act, 1996, with the mandate to extend telecommunications services to unserved, underserved, rural and remote communities.
USF has implemented projects under two broad categories—access projects and backhaul projects.
Access projects have evolved from providing voice and basic data services through 2G networks in unserved mauzas to high-speed broadband services through 3G and 4G networks. The programme has also been extended to unserved road segments and tourist locations.
Since inception, USF has provided voice and broadband data services to more than 38.4 million people across 22,100-plus mauzas, according to the ministry.
It has also provided broadband coverage to more than 2,500 kilometres of unserved road segments on national highways and motorways, along with eight tourist destinations and approximately 50 kilometres of access routes.
Under the OFC programme, USF has deployed more than 18,300 kilometres of optic fibre since inception and connected 1,089 unserved tehsil headquarters, union councils and towns.
The ministry said the OFC projects had evolved from connecting unserved tehsil headquarters and towns to extending connectivity to union councils and other areas with access-network infrastructure, thereby expanding the overall fibre footprint in unserved and underserved regions.
According to the government, improved connectivity in remote areas was generating socio-economic benefits by expanding access to education, healthcare, emergency services, financial inclusion, e-governance and economic opportunities.
The ministry maintained that USF projects had produced significant improvements in connectivity, particularly in areas where telecom operators had little commercial incentive to deploy infrastructure.
It said USF would continue identifying and serving unserved and underserved areas across the country through broadband access and fibre-optic infrastructure projects.
